name: Blinded
summary: You can't see and auto-fail sight-based checks. Attack rolls against you have advantage; your attack rolls have disadvantage.

name: Charmed
summary: You can't attack the charmer or target them with damaging abilities or spells. The charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact with you socially.

name: Deafened
summary: You can't hear and auto-fail hearing-based checks.

name: Frightened
summary: You have disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight. You can't willingly move closer to that source.

name: Grappled
summary: Your speed is 0 and can't increase. You have disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than the grappler. The grappler can drag you but spends 1 extra foot of movement per foot (unless you're Tiny or two+ sizes smaller).

name: Incapacitated
summary: You can't take actions, bonus actions, or reactions. Your concentration ends. You can't speak. If incapacitated when rolling initiative, you have disadvantage on the roll.

name: Invisible
summary: Creatures can't see you without special senses. You have advantage on attack rolls; attack rolls against you have disadvantage.

name: Paralyzed
summary: You are incapacitated; speed 0. You auto-fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against you have advantage. Hits from attackers within 5 feet are critical hits.

name: Petrified
summary: You are incapacitated and can't move or speak. You have resistance to all damage and immunity to poison and disease.

name: Poisoned
summary: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
summary: You can only crawl or spend half your speed (round down) to stand. Your attack rolls have disadvantage. Melee attacks against you have advantage; other attacks against you have disadvantage.

name: Restrained
summary: Your speed is 0 and can't increase. Attack rolls against you have advantage; your attack rolls have disadvantage. You have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

name: Stunned
summary: You are incapacitated. You auto-fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attack rolls against you have advantage.

name: Unconscious
summary: You are incapacitated and prone, and drop what you're holding (you stay prone when the condition ends). Speed 0. Attacks against you have advantage. Any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.
